messages:
alex: 🎙️ All-hands going live in 2! Streaming to the usual channel. Who's on trombone duty for the celebration? :tada:
maria: I brought a box of mystery pastries. No guarantees on contents. :grimacing:
aj: I nominate the office plant (Fernie) as our honorary mascot. Polaroid pic incoming.
samira: @alex can we get a quick clap train when engineering tries to pronounce 'quantization' correctly? :clap:
kevin: If anyone wants the pastries, come by 3rd floor lounge after. I left a sticky note: "Help yourself, don't ask what's inside" :joy:
jamie: i'll do trombone sound effects from my phone. poor audio but full heart. :trombone:
rebecca-bot: Reminder: All-hands + photo wall. Upload polaroids to #people-ops by EOD.
alex: ok team — live chat rules: be kind, short, and post memes only after the CEO's slide on growth (kidding?) :sweat_smile:
maria: also, sticker leaderboard update: @samira passed @kevin by 1 sticker. challenge accepted. :sticker:
aj: vote poll — mystery pastry: savory or sweet? react :one: savory, :two: sweet
samira: sweet all the way. savory is a bold move and i respect it.
kevin: savory. but I'll take both. :raised_hands:
jamie: gif: tiny dog cheering (replied with :doge:)
alex: love it. 2-minute warning, then we flood with happy trombone. :party_parrot:
rebecca-bot: Event reminder: afterparty snacks run until 4pm. Don't be late! :alarm_clock:
